name: Capresso Infinity
details: Electric conical burr grinder with 16 settings.

notes.turkish: Honest Coffee Guide lists no Turkish range.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): espresso 1–3, moka pot 3–7, AeroPress 3–12, V60 4–8, filter coffee machine 2–11, French press 8–16, cold brew 10–16; Turkish N/A. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
